name: Channel Requests
description: Lets non-admins request new channels for admin approval, with configurable naming rules and automatic member add.

settings_schema.header:
## Channel Requests

Lets non-admins **request** channels instead of creating them directly. Requests are posted to the approval channel below; System Admins (and optionally Team Admins) can approve or deny.

Pick the approval team + channel via the dropdowns, then configure domain prefixes so channels follow your naming convention automatically. Requesters see a form with a prefix picker + tab-complete member + Channel Admin selectors.

settings.help_text: When enabled, users can request the creation of new channels. Turn this off to hide the channel-request entry points and reject channel-request submissions.
When enabled, users can request the creation of new teams for admin approval.
When enabled, users can request incoming webhooks for a channel, delivered privately once approved.
Dropdown of teams you're a member of. Pick the team containing your approval channel.
Dropdown of channels in the selected team. Pick the channel where new channel requests get posted for approval.

Structured editor: define allowed channel prefixes (team-, project-, etc.) with descriptions and suffix rules. Requesters pick from a dropdown; the resulting channel URL is prefix+suffix. Includes preset packs for common org shapes and a live preview.
When enabled, Team Admins of the approval team can click Approve/Deny in addition to System Admins.
Tab-complete picker: pick users whose channel requests bypass approval and create the channel immediately. Useful for delegated managers.
When set, every approve/deny action logs a message to this channel. Useful for compliance.
